formal_protocol.track: Independent per-source evolution from zero; frozen five-question batches and three VAL-selected candidates; controlled shared evidence, not full official leaderboard results
formal_protocol.excluded_from_core_slot_total: Terminal states, mechanism ablations and G/GO are not enabled. Evidence preparation and judge calls counted separately; slots are not API calls

result_record_schema.test_slice: clean_unseen; historical RR exposed/reserved tasks are unused in v6
result_record_schema.generator_bundle_sha256: string; identical across source self-test and all transfer benchmarks for a source/run

result_record_schema.official_score: number|null; RR only unless official evaluator equivalence is separately established
result_record_schema.official_leaderboard_equivalent: boolean; false for adapted DSQA/DR Bench II judges

notes: Populate exclusively from actual sealed runs under independent_protocol_v6. Each of three source benchmarks starts from zero for each of three runs, giving nine independent trajectories. Forty EVO questions form eight batches: all five questions read one unchanged state, then three candidates branch from that state and each runs the same ten source VAL questions; a whole-state winner feeds the next batch. The eighth-batch winner is the final state. Each source/run package applies unchanged to its self-test and the three transfer benchmarks; default packages use run 0 for each source. RR18 formerly quarantined tasks remain unused; the ten unselected original RR VAL tasks moved to EVO with user authorization, preserving current VAL/TEST. VAL and TEST use one artifact per task/state; source-order replicates do not estimate same-state answer variance. Small subset confidence intervals may be wide; no full-benchmark/SOTA result is implied. Missing native scores stay null. Interrupted historical v5 runs and request stress checks are not new campaign results.

paper_identity.title: JIT-Compose: Evolving Multi-Agent Workflow Synthesis for Open-Ended Generation

checkpoint_selection_plan.selection: After each batch, select among exactly three candidates using fixed theoretical task-range normalization and the mean of ten fixed source VAL tasks; eligibility requires 9/10 complete. Maximum-relative 1e-12 tie, then completion/candidate index/state hash
checkpoint_selection_plan.continue_from: Each batch VAL winner, before its next five-question batch starts
checkpoint_selection_plan.final_selected_state: Eighth-batch winner; no global selection across previous batches
checkpoint_selection_plan.candidate_branching: All three candidates use the same batch input state and five completed task records
checkpoint_selection_plan.ineligible_batch: Trajectory inconclusive; preserve missing downstream scores without resampling

statistical_families.primary: Holm across six selected-minus-initial contrasts: three source self-tests plus three source-to-DR Bench II transfers
statistical_families.instruction_diagnostics: Separate Holm family across six selected-minus-initial contrasts: three sources by IFEval/IFBench
statistical_families.secondary_baselines: Separate Holm families across twelve primary and twelve instruction diagnostic selected-minus-JIT/fixed contrasts
statistical_families.researchrubrics_mechanisms: Not enabled; requires separate registration before additional testing
